scope: Practical discovery and cover hierarchy, following the Breathr comparison
changes: Homepage city/area and time selector uses existing eligible guides and exact Compass filters, with direct arrival at results.
Unsupported time choices are disabled and reset when changing area. No geolocation, account or live availability claims.
Experience cards show existing reviewed time and participation lenses rather than repeated public-guide badges.
Five curated cover editions have individually reviewed desktop and mobile lead crops. Other guides remain in the catalogue.
Larger desktop lead photograph, quieter secondary titles and stronger caption contrast within the existing palette.
Recent homepage guides diversify activity fields as well as countries.

functionalChecks: London plus short visit returns five guides and scrolls to compass-results.
Changing from London short visit to Wadi Rum resets an unsupported time selection.
Mobile grid and list preserve all five planning fact blocks.
All five cover lead images visually inspected at desktop and mobile sizes.
Existing canonical URLs, single page heading and absence of Google tag before consent checked on sampled routes.
verification.accessibilityScope: Semantic labels, keyboard-compatible native controls, focus styles, target sizes, visual readability and responsive overflow. Not a full accessibility certification.
verification.finalFormAnchor: Verified in browser after final build.

measurementBoundary: Functional correctness and visual regressions were checked. Increased retention, conversion or engagement has not been demonstrated by user research or an A/B test.
contentAndRights: No new guide claims, photos, licenses, providers or booking promises introduced. Existing photo credits and source links preserved.
deployment: See commit deployment status and final task report.
